integrity.claim_scope: Exact labeled idempotent associative algebra endomorphism rank distribution in the split B_lambda family for every n>=1, prime power q and nonzero lambda.
integrity.mathematical_basis: Nondegenerate bilinear reduction to totally isotropic images; two-sided Goursat count and classical symplectic and split-orthogonal frame formulas; bounded finite tests corroborate.

scientific_limitations: The central-sum family was previously classified, and the alternating/Heisenberg retraction spectrum was previously established. Finite-field symmetric isotropic counts are classical. The all-phase classification does not cover every extra-special algebra, arbitrary endomorphisms or conjugacy orbits. Absolute priority cannot be guaranteed; no formal or external expert certification is claimed.
title: Complete retraction-rank spectra of split bilinear-product algebras over finite fields
